intro: Covers the US session of Tuesday 24 November. This is the 08:15 retry; SPI futures direction could not be resolved across sources, so the futures figure and implied open are not available.
footnotes: Index closes and VIX per Yahoo Finance, cross-checked against Trading Economics CFD prices (S&P 500 -0.50%, Dow +0.90%, VIX 26.36 -0.26%). Nasdaq Composite had no second source (TE Nasdaq-100 CFD -1.99%).
Brent, gold, AUD/USD, 10-year and iron ore are Trading Economics CFD/OTC snapshots for 24 Nov; FNArena's Monday 10-year figure was 4.92% vs TE's 4.95% previous, so the change is TE's.
Iron ore is unchanged on the day and may be a stale assessed price.

setup.summary: SPI 200 futures: not available. Sources conflict on direction: TradingView shows the Dec contract at 8,719 (-0.25%, "no trades", undated); Investing.com shows 8,720 (+0.14%, stale snapshot); FNArena's last confirmed reading (8,716, +1.49%) is from Tuesday morning. No implied open is calculated. The ASX 200 closed Tuesday at 8,726.40, up 155.84 points (+1.82%) from Monday's 8,570.60, ending an eight-day losing streak.

local_events: October monthly CPI is due and expected to be high on credit-card surcharge pass-throughs (FNArena; release time not confirmed).
what_moved: Tech led the decline: the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.48% and the S&P 500 0.50%, while the Dow rose 0.85%, giving back part of Monday's surge (S&P +4.73%, Nasdaq +6.51%) that followed Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO. Gold fell 2.32% after Monday's 2.8% jump; Brent rose 1.7% after Monday's slide on Russia-Ukraine peace-talk hopes. S&P 500 sector performance and Tuesday-specific drivers could not be verified: not available.

news.headline: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO.
news.summary: Monday's rally was the biggest since 2008 on short covering and dealer hedge unwinds, adding over US$900bn to Nvidia's market value; Huang faces a House committee on 1 December.

news.headline: Fed December pricing.
news.summary: Markets had priced a 25bp December hike with the 50bp option dropped; the 10-year closed the week to 20 Nov at 4.92%.

news.headline: ECB and euro-area PMIs.
news.summary: ANZ expects a 25bp ECB hike in December to 2.75%; November composite PMI was 55.0 in Germany (prior 53.4) and 46.2 in France (prior 46.4).

news.headline: Oil swings on Ukraine talks.
news.summary: Brent fell 3.5% to US$89.32/bbl on Monday on Russia-Ukraine peace-talk hopes, then rose 1.7% on Tuesday.

news.headline: Australian October CPI due today.
news.summary: The print is expected to be high on credit-card surcharge pass-throughs.

news.headline: ASX 200 ends losing streak.
news.summary: The index rallied 1.82% on Tuesday on broad-based gains.

coming_up: US October PCE inflation print this week; House committee questioning of Huang on 1 December; RBA rates decision on 8 December (per FNArena).
